interventions.name: LIHTC development (median total development cost)
interventions.notes: Source: "the median per-unit TDC for LIHTC properties was $164,757" for projects developed and placed into service 2011-2016 (Abt Associates for NCSHA, 2018). Total development cost including land. Caveats: this median covers all LIHTC projects (new construction and rehab together; the report says new construction cost more than rehab), and it is in nominal 2011-2016 dollars, not adjusted for inflation. It therefore understates current new-construction cost.

interventions.name: Hotel / motel conversion (California Homekey)
interventions.notes: Source: "All funds have now been awarded, totaling more than $835 million to 48 applicants (93 projects), totaling 6,055 units. The statewide average cost to Project Homekey is $139,000 per unit." (California Senate background paper citing HCD, Oct 30, 2020; Homekey Round 1). Caveat: this is the state Homekey award per unit and excludes local matching funds and later rehab. It is a California-only figure, not a national one.
